🇦🇹 Ukrainian intelligence officers re-arrested in Austria Two employees of the Ukrainian military intelligence were taken back into custody in Vienna. They had been released on bail two weeks ago, but analysis of seized phones and computers provided new grounds for arrest. According to ORF, electronic devices contained data on the alleged preparation of illegal intelligence operations not only in Austria but also in the UK. This may involve kidnapping individuals whom Kiev seeks to prosecute. Potential targets included figures in economic cases whose extradition Ukraine previously demanded from London. ORF also recalls statements by former Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko, who claimed GUR officers planned to track him and use violence on orders from Zelensky's office. Austrian prosecutors confirmed the re-imprisonment but withheld details due to case secrecy. @Slavyangrad
